mechanism: Both drugs can cause electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia/hyperkalemia imbalance) and may impair renal function, with zoledronic acid carrying nephrotoxicity risk that could affect eplerenone clearance.
action: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and renal function regularly; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion and consider dosing adjustments if renal function declines.
